cases.reason: Request anonymous interface shape assessed; unchanged whole source requires additional application, HTTP and Android dependency support. No compile claim.
rootListener extends a class and declares mutable properties, explicitly outside the supported interface-only shape.
Anonymous Continuation implementations require parameterized interface, properties and Result value-class semantics.

limitations: Single nongeneric nonsealed interface with ordinary override methods, exact parameter/result JVM descriptors, lexical captures, fresh allocation, own and enclosing receivers. Properties, class/multiple/generic supertypes, generic methods, empty marker implementations, annotations and covariant/erased bridges remain explicit unsupported boundaries. Generic inline lambdas with unconditional nonlocal returns still require unsupported Nothing inference; conditional method returns are exercised.

Same Java caller compiles once against official provider and runs with -Xverify:all against both. Official and candidate Kotlin consumers compile separately against both providers. Public provider ABI is compared; generated anonymous class names and private capture layouts are not ABI claims.

Generated classes omit EnclosingMethod and anonymous-class Kotlin metadata. Reflection equivalence for Class.isAnonymousClass, isLocalClass, enclosingMethod and Kotlin reflection is unsupported and unverified.

AndroidBible source inspection motivates scope; no unchanged whole AndroidBible file, full application, APK/device or full Kotlin compatibility claim. Upstream CoroutineHelpers requires generic Continuation, Result value class and property support beyond this scope.
